items.title: FedEx (FDX) Shareholders Will Vote On Three Governance Proposals
items.summary: FedEx (NYSE: FDX) will face multiple shareholder proposals on board chair independence, shareholder powers, and product distribution oversight at its upcoming annual meeting. Investors are seeking an independent board chair role that is separate from FedEx's executive leadership. Additional proposals focus on expanding shareholder rights and reviewing FedEx's role in distributing mail order abortion drugs.
